The prior experiment EXP-021 showed zone-level A/B overstated the lift because of this kind of interference. The plan also runs only 5 days, which is under the 14-day minimum, and states no MDE or power calculation.","evidence_quote":"A/B test randomized by driver. Run for 5 days. Compare on-time rate between arms.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-021-peak-surge-incentive"],"recommendation":"Use a design that contains interference, such as market-level or switchback randomization, and track neighboring zones. Run at least 14 days, and document the MDE and power calculation against the 87% to 89% On-Time Delivery Rate target."}]}
